title: Chart of Accounts
groupsNote: Predefined groups are Tally's 15 primary groups. Custom groups are sub-groups you create under a primary group for finer classification.
noInSub: No ledgers in this subgroup yet
syncTip: Auto-create ledgers for existing vendors, banks, cash, owners + seed GST/expense ledgers
subHint: e.g. Travel Expenses, Office Expenses, Bank Charges
parentHelp: The parent group determines P&L vs Balance Sheet classification
ledgerHint: e.g. Rent Expense, Owner A, ABC Suppliers
groupHelp: Determines P&L vs Balance Sheet classification
openingHelp: Enter as positive. Debit-nature groups (assets/expenses) show as Dr; credit-nature (liabilities/capital/income) as Cr.
confirmDelLedger: Delete ledger "{{n}}"? This cannot be undone.
confirmDelGroup: Delete group "{{n}}"? Ledgers using it will need to be reclassified.
needSync: {{n}} ledgers need to be created. Click "Sync Ledgers" to auto-create ledgers for:
noCustom: No custom groups yet. Create a sub-group (e.g. "Travel Expenses" under "Indirect Expenses") for finer classification in reports.
noLedgers: No ledgers found. Click "Sync Ledgers" to auto-create ledgers for your existing vendors, banks, and owners, or click "New Ledger" to create one manually.
